venues.name: The Bell House

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: On show days, The Bell House opens its doors one hour before venue doors open. For events with special circumstances, please check the event's ticketing page for specific opening times.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: We accept both cash and card payments at the box office and at our bars. For the most seamless experience, we recommend using a card.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call tickets are available for pickup at the box office approximately 1 hour before doors open on the day of the show. Please make sure that you have a photo ID matching the purchasers name to pick up tickets. Guests are not permitted to put tickets in will call for other guests to pick up. You will need to arrange to meet your party at the facility to deliver tickets. If tickets or passes are being left for you they will only be left at the box office. This includes meet and greet passes, backstage passes, press passes and tickets from the tour or other promotional company. These tickets will be available approximately 1 hour before doors on the day of the show. If your tickets/passes are not in will call you will need to contact the person that left them for you to determine where they are. The box office cannot contact any member of the tour for you.

venues.parkingDetail: Street parking is available, but we recommend using public transit. By Subway: Take the F, G or R Train to the Smith 9th Streets station. Its a short walk from there. By Bus: The B61 bus stops nearby.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: For all guest accommodations, please email us at TheBellHouse@LiveNation.com to coordinate accommodations in advance of the show. Unexpected Needs: If you have had an injury or illness that requires seating, email TheBellHouse@LiveNation.com to coordinate accommodations in advance of the show. We have a limited number of seats available on the day of the show for such issues, but we cannot guarantee we will be able to seat you. Please remember that accessible seating permits for the guest with the accessible need and one companion. Interpreter Requests: If you will need an interpreter for an event, please give us at least 2 weeks notice to secure. Guests that request an interpreter will need to pick up their tickets at will call. When the tickets are picked up we will introduce you to your interpreter for the evening and take you to your seats. There is no charge to arrange for an interpreter for your visit. Hearing Assistance: Guests that require assisted listening devices can contact our venue office prior to the event to arrange for a device. Please give us at least 2 weeks notice. We can be reached via email TheBellHouse@LiveNation.com. Service Animals: Service animals are permitted inside the venue during events. Only registered working animals are permitted. The Bell House requires, consistent with the ADA, that service animals must be harnessed, leashed, or tethered, unless these devices interfere with the service animals work or the individuals disability prevents them from using these devices. Individuals who cannot use such devices must maintain control of the animal through voice, signal, or other effective methods. Wheelchairs: Our venue is wheelchair accessible. Accommodations: Our venue bathrooms, bar, and merchandise area are accessible. For any further questions or updates, feel free to contact us at TheBellHouse@LiveNation.com

generalInfo.generalRule: For a complete list of FAQs and information to help better plan your visit, please review the Plan Your Visit portion of our website: https://www.thebellhouseny.com/visit
generalInfo.childRule: This is a 21+ venue. For events that allow for ages under 21, they must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian. You must present a valid ID at check in. Each shows specific age requirements can be found by visiting the events corresponding ticketing page. If you have questions about a specific show, please email TheBellHouse@LiveNation.com

presales.description: Live Nation Presales are available exclusively to Live Nation All Access members. It only takes a minute to join and membership is free. Sign into Ticketmaster with the same email address you use for All Access to automatically unlock the presale (no presale codes).
presales.shortDescription: Available exclusively to Live Nation All Access members
presales.linkDescription: Join for Free to Unlock Presale

event.pleaseNote: Kevin Sullivan is a LA-based comic known for his cosmic twist on comedy! In addition to his work on stage, Kevin has amassed over half a million followers on social media, where he's built a devoted fanbase by blending comedy w/ astrology, turning zodiac signs into punchlines. He also co-hosts the hit podcast Two Broke Gays & is now selling out shows on his Aquarian Contrarian tour, proving no matter your sign, laughing at yourself is always in the stars! Door Time: 6:30pm (front bar opens @ 5:30pm). Show Time: 7:30pm. 21 & over w/ valid, government-issued photo ID. This event is General Admission Preferred Seating & a mix of General Admission Seating & Standing Room. *All seating is 1st come, 1st served & not guaranteed. Arrive early for best selection. If you have an accessibility request, please email thebellhouse@livenation.com prior. *No outside food, drink. $.25 per each ticket sold for a majority of events at The Bell House benefits Comedy Gives Back.
